AdvanceWebUI enables seamless file management on the Cardputer ZERO through a Web‑based interface. Using either an Access Point or a Wi‑Fi connection, you can upload multiple files, download files directly from the device to your PC or phone, and install .deb packages via the WebUI.

apps.title: Gemini Live
apps.summary: Live speech-to-speech AI voice assistant with streaming transcripts.
apps.description:
Gemini Live turns the Cardputer Zero into a real-time conversational voice assistant powered by the Google Gemini Live API (BidiGenerateContent).

Speak naturally into the built-in microphone and hear spoken replies through the speaker while both sides of the conversation stream live on the 320x170 screen — user prompts anchored on the right and assistant replies on the left, each with an inline voice waveform indicator. Press ESC or key 6 while the assistant is speaking to interrupt the reply and immediately start listening again, or press key 5 to clear the history and start a fresh conversation context.

In Settings, configure your Google AI Studio API key (with a built-in QR code link and Ctrl+V clipboard paste), pick from live-capable Gemini models (including extended-thinking models), select a prebuilt voice (Kore, Puck, Charon, Fenrir, Aoede, Leda, Orus, Vesta, Zephyr), and customize the system instructions using the full-screen English/Ukrainian (EN/UA) keyboard editor with Sym, Shift, Fn, Ctrl, Alt layer highlights and Ctrl+C / Ctrl+V clipboard support.

apps.title: RFID
apps.summary: NFC/UHF scan, saved dumps, NTAG emulation and RFID tools
apps.description:
RFID 1.0.3 for CardputerZero: READ, SAVED, EMU and TOOLS for M5 NFC CAP (SPI), M5 NFC Unit (IIC), PN532, PN532Killer and compatible UHF readers. Includes saved MFC dump writing, MFKey32v2/MFKey64/Staticnested tools and JSON-backed NTAG emulation. Hardware support varies by function; an external reader is required.

1.0.3 restores the panel mode from the board firmware at startup, after CAP operations and on clean exit; Gen1A Saved writes reuse one unlocked session, check every write ACK and finish without read-back verification. Other write modes retain verification. Prefixed dump key export is corrected, and source modules/tests/build tools are reorganized.

SPI MFC 1K encrypted emulation remains experimental and disabled by default because restart authentication regression is unresolved. Its kernel helper is not installed by this package. The intermittent panel-mode trigger remains under investigation; this release adds recovery.

apps.title: TalkToMe
apps.summary: Offline neural text-to-speech: type English or Ukrainian, hear it spoken.
apps.description:
TalkToMe turns the Cardputer Zero into a talking device: type text, pick a voice and hear it spoken on the built-in speaker. Synthesis runs entirely on the device with a compact neural TTS engine, so your text never leaves it: no network, no account, no cloud service.

Voices: Linda (English) and Mykyta, Oleksa, Tetiana and Serhiy (Ukrainian). All voices ship with the app and nothing is downloaded at run time.

Numbers, dates, times, money and percentages are read out in words with correct grammar, in Ukrainian down to case endings and word stress. Ukrainian text is shown with the stress the voice used.

Keys: Enter opens the text editor with an on-screen keyboard map, Alt switches between English and Ukrainian input, Enter speaks and Esc stops. Space reads a random sample line. In the editor, hold Fn+Z/C to move by character, Fn+Ctrl+Z/C by word and Fn+F/X to jump to the start or end. Ctrl+C and Ctrl+V copy and paste through the system clipboard.

apps.title: Telega
apps.summary: Unofficial Telegram client: chats, photos, voice messages, EN/UA typing.
apps.description:
Telega is an unofficial Telegram client built for the Cardputer Zero keyboard and 320x170 screen. Sign in by scanning a QR code with the Telegram app on your phone, or with a phone number and login code.

The chat list follows your Telegram folders (New, All and your own tabs), shows pinned, muted and unread state, and searches by name as you type. Open a chat to read history with read ticks and day separators, reply, react, delete, view and save photos, send images from the device, and record or play voice messages on the built-in microphone and speaker. Forum groups open as a list of threads.

Typing uses a full-screen editor with an on-screen keyboard map: Alt switches between English and Ukrainian (transliterated from the Latin keys), SYM lights up the symbols each key will type, Fn+Z/C and Fn+F/X move the cursor, and Ctrl+C / Ctrl+V go through the system clipboard. Every screen lists its keys at the bottom, and Fn+J saves a screenshot.

Telega is not affiliated with Telegram. It is built on TDLib and uses its own application credentials; your account data stays on the device in your home directory.

apps.title: TIC-80
apps.summary: TIC-80 fantasy computer: make, play and share tiny retro games
apps.description:
TIC-80 is a fantasy computer for making, playing and sharing tiny games, by Vadim Grigoruk (nesbox). This is an unofficial build for the CardputerZero, not affiliated with nesbox.

- Runs on the internal panel: the 240x136 TIC-80 screen at scale 1 inside its border.
- Gamepad on the keyboard: F/X/Z/C move, L/K are A/B, O/I are X/Y. Change it in the game menu under Options.
- Console and code editor work from the keyboard. Write games in Lua, JavaScript, Python, Fennel, MoonScript, Wren, Janet, Squirrel, Scheme, Forth or WASM.
- Type demo in the console to install the demo carts, then load quest.tic and run.

The sprite, map and music editors expect a mouse. Type exit in the console to go back to the launcher.

TIC-80: https://tic80.com
Source: https://github.com/nesbox/TIC-80
Docs: https://github.com/nesbox/TIC-80/wiki

apps.description:
Browse websites, search the web and download files. Zero Browser is designed for the Cardputer Zero small screen and built-in keyboard. Choose QtWebKit for general browsing with Javascript support, or NetSurf for lightweight browsing on simpler websites.

Zero Browser is experimental. Some websites may reject this unfamiliar browser or fail to load due to JavaScript incompatibilities. It should not be used for sensitive activities or anything requiring security. Don't expect it to work like a regular browser capable of handling large, complex web applications. This browser is based on old WebKit revision with known unpatched vulnerabilities. Please use it carefully and avoid visiting untrusted websites and using it for transmission of sensitive data.

apps.title: ZeroRadio
apps.summary: Pocket radio lab: SDR, scanner, memories, ADS-B, AIS and ISM
apps.description:
ZeroRadio turns the CardputerZero into a pocket receiver. Plug an RTL-SDR dongle (for example the RTL-SDR Blog V4) into the USB-A port and open the hub.

- SDR: spectrum and waterfall up to 2 MHz wide, WFM/NFM/AM/USB/LSB/CW audio on the speaker, squelch, and a frequency correction for the dongle (CAL) shown in ppm and Hz.
- Scanner: sweep a wide band, list the strongest signals at their exact frequency, open one in the SDR with Enter.
- Memories: press M in the SDR or the Scanner to save a frequency, then rename, regroup or delete it, open it in the SDR with its mode, or scan a group and stop where a signal comes in.
- ISM: 433/868 MHz weather sensors, tyre pressure sensors and remotes.
- ADS-B: aircraft list, radar and world map at 1090 MHz.
- AIS: ship list, radar and world map at 162 MHz.

Every decoder runs on the device, with no computer or network. Set your position by city, coordinates or GPS (Cap LoRa-1262-GPS or a USB GPS). Press H in any app for its help. The package bundles readsb and AIS-catcher (GPL-3.0); see Credits in the app.

apps.title: ZeroSky
apps.summary: Pocket AR planetarium: point the device at the sky and see what is there
apps.description:
ZeroSky shows the real sky, live. It computes the stars, constellations, planets, Sun and Moon for the time and your position, and draws them in the direction you point the CardputerZero.

- Sky: 5,070 stars, 605 Messier, NGC and IC objects, constellation figures with their names, and the Solar System. The star limit follows daylight and twilight.
- Pointing: the IMU follows the device. Calibrate the compass outdoors with a guided figure 8 and it also finds true north; without it, align north with the arrows.
- Find: type a name, and an arrow and rising beeps lead you to the object.
- Camera: draw the sky over the live image and align it with the stars you see.
- Red night theme, blue day theme, location by city, coordinates or GPS.

Everything runs on the device, with no network. Press H for help in seven languages. Pointing accuracy and the camera lens field (an estimated 62.2 degrees) are not yet measured against the night sky.

apps.title: ZeroTracker
apps.summary: Pocket music tracker that reads and writes M8 songs and instruments
apps.description:
ZeroTracker is a music tracker for the CardputerZero, inspired by the M8 tracker and compatible with its song (.m8s) and instrument (.m8i) files.

- Eight tracks of songs, chains, phrases, instruments and tables.
- FM, WAV, MACRO (Braids models), HYPER and SAMPLER engines, with modulators, EQ and a sample editor that records from the microphone.
- Mixer with chorus, delay, reverb, master limiter and oscilloscopes.
- RENDER the song to WAV: the mix and a stem per track.
- LIBRARY: download packs of songs, instruments and samples on the device.
- Seven languages, themes, and a tooltip for every key (SYM + 4..8).

At the first start it creates ~/ZeroTracker with a demo song, instruments and a CC0 sample kit. APP > MANUAL shows a QR code to the getting-started guide. Not affiliated with Dirtywave.
